svg.title: OpenCourseDeck — Make Studio View
svg.desc: Purposeful creation hub with three starting paths (Cornell Note, SM-2 Card, Concept Map), rich Markdown editor, and recent artifact history.

g.text: Ground your study artifacts in evidence from courses, books, or direct synthesis.
Timestamped cues, main synthesis body, and bottom summary block.
Cloze deletions, QA pairs, and automated ease factor scheduling.
Connect concepts, attach video clips, and draw mental topologies.
In state machine replication, the backup must mirror all memory state transitions of the primary identically.
If a network partition isolates the primary, the viewserver must wait for the old primary to acknowledge lease expiration.
Lease expiration and synchronous NVRAM persistence guarantee safety under partition.
